anomalies.summary: A table row cut by an unescaped '|' that leaves its cell count equal to the header's gets no Note, so the cut statement is reported as if whole.
anomalies.workaround: Escape every '|' inside a table cell as '\|' or put it in a backtick span; review rows whose statement ends abruptly.

anomalies.summary: Citation is literal: a test that mentions an id as data, for example in an asserted error message, cites it exactly as a test that proves it does.
anomalies.workaround: Put 'speccheck:ignore' on lines that mention an id without realizing it; run the mock judge, which requires an assertion token in the citing test.

anomalies.summary: The manifest proves which results file a run read, not that the results came from running the tests of the checked tree.
anomalies.workaround: Produce the results file and run check in the same CI job, and keep that job's record with the manifest.

anomalies.summary: The Lean model in proof/ was transcribed from v1.18; its exit map does not include the v1.25 condition that an UNCONTROLLED hazard fails --strict.
anomalies.workaround: Rely on the acceptance tests and OQ-04 for that condition until proof/ is rebuilt.

anomalies.summary: No operational-qualification case challenges the JavaScript/TypeScript adapter: there is no packaged fixture with goldens for it.
anomalies.workaround: A team relying on the JavaScript/TypeScript adapter adds a case to its own performance qualification on its own project.
